events.region: SW Kenai Peninsula; NW Kenai Peninsula; Skilak Lake
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Visibility down to a quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...NW Kenai Peninsula, SW Kenai Peninsula, and Skilak Lake.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to low visibility. Near
to below freezing temperatures may lead to frost on bridges and
roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of dense fog will affect portions of the
Sterling Highway corridor tonight into Wednesday morning, including
in and around Kenai, Soldotna and Cooper Landing.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County coastal areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM PDT Thursday during high tides in the late
mornings.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur in the
late mornings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents and managers of
infrastructure in the warned area should prepare for rising
water and take appropriate action to protect life and
property. High tides each day will occur in the late morning.
Observed high tides are 1.4 to 1.6 feet above astronomical
tide predictions.
